summary: Full-stack testing of admin mass messaging feature (/mensajes). Backend: 12/12 pytest in test_messaging.py passed covering admin-only guards (anonymous & student get 401/403), seed-once of 4 default templates (deleting 'Aviso general' does NOT re-seed), template CRUD, preview with variable substitution + markdown links rendered as <a> + HTML in body escaped (<script> -> <script>), audience counts for students/all/course/inactive, POST /admin/messages/test to delivered@resend.dev, and a full campaign send on a dedicated TEST course containing only 2 delivered+msgtest@resend.dev students -- campaign went status 'enviando' -> 'completado' with sent=2 failed=0 within ~2s. Empty-course audience returns 400. Frontend: logged in as admin via OTP (token injected into localStorage), navigated to /mensajes, verified sidebar 'Mensajes masivos' link, templates-list shows 4 seeded templates with correct names, template-item click loads editor, insert-var-nombre inserts {nombre}, new template saved appears in list, audience=course + course picker displays correct count=2 in preview iframe with variables substituted (UI0/UI1, 'TEST UI Msgs Course') and body rendered, audience=inactive shows audience-days input, message-test sends to delivered@resend.dev successfully, campaigns-history section renders, template-delete removes template. No console errors other than one expected pre-auth 401 for /auth/me before token injection. All TEST data cleaned up (templates, campaigns, course, users, enrollments). 4 default templates intact post-run.
critical_code_review_comments: messaging.recipients() for 'all' audience fetches ALL active users then does per-user find_one on enrollments to resolve latest course — O(N) extra queries that could slow large sends. Consider aggregating or batching via $lookup/precomputed last-enrollment map.

messaging.run_campaign has fire-and-forget asyncio.create_task; if the backend restarts mid-send, in-flight campaigns remain stuck in 'enviando' with no resume logic. Minor; acceptable for current scale.
0.6s sleep per recipient is sequential and will take ~10 min per 1000 recipients. Fine for now but a batched async send (e.g. gather in chunks) would scale better.
No audit of who was emailed per campaign (only aggregate sent/failed counts). Consider storing a per-recipient delivery log for troubleshooting.
render_body escapes HTML correctly and markdown links use style color #11305c inline — good. But generic auto-URL regex can mis-match trailing punctuation; low priority.
Preview endpoint uses first user as sample; if 'all' audience lists non-estudiante users first, sample {curso} may be empty — this is handled by vars_for fallback to 'tu curso'. OK.
seed_data_creation: Transient: 1 TEST course (TEST Mensajes Course for backend + TEST UI Msgs Course for frontend), 4 TEST users (delivered+msgtest/uitest@resend.dev), their enrollments, and transient TEST templates/campaigns -- all deleted. 4 default templates and app_meta 'templates_seeded' doc intact.
